input_contract.source_shards: exact 1297 manifest-bound DESIGN/{date}/h1_1200.parquet files; exactly one 12:00 UTC BID H1 row each
input_contract.atr20_source: exact manifest-bound DESIGN/{date}.json field atr20 from immutable trendstack_002_decision_packet.v1; never recompute ATR and never derive it from HYP007 12:00 bar
input_contract.forbidden_inputs: public custody shards, raw H1, HYP006 partial output, M1, VALIDATION_FEATURE_ONLY packets, sealed VALIDATION/HOLDOUT, any prior economic output

join_and_arms.join_key: date == source manifest date == ledger opportunity_id == decision packet opportunity_id

execution_math.long_exit: stop when low <= long_stop else 12:00 BID close
execution_math.short_exit: stop when high >= short_stop else 12:00 BID close

metric_contract.pf_status: FINITE when loss>0; NO_LOSS with null PF when loss=0,gain>0 and passes absolute PF; NO_WIN_NO_LOSS with null PF when both zero and fails
metric_contract.relative_pf: finite delta; challenger NO_LOSS vs finite=POSITIVE_INFINITY pass; finite vs comparator NO_LOSS=NEGATIVE_INFINITY fail; both NO_LOSS=ZERO_BOTH_NO_LOSS delta0 fail; any NO_WIN_NO_LOSS=UNDEFINED fail; encode status strings and null, never JSON Infinity
metric_contract.dsr: per-trade 1.50-pip net-R; sample Sharpe n-1 for each arm; zero stddev Sharpe=0; sample variance across four arm Sharpes; STACK population skew and non-excess kurtosis with zero moment fallback 0/3; n_obs=661,n_trials=4; call canonical dsr.py

twelve_gates: STACK PF 1.50 delta vs better standalone PF >= 0.15
STACK mean netR 1.50 delta vs better standalone mean >= 0.05
STACK mean netR 1.50 delta vs DISAGREE >= 0.05

terminal_logic.engineering_invalid: no market verdict; no fabricated PF/WR/expectancy
terminal_logic.economic_kill: engineering valid and any of 12 gates fails; kill exact HYP007 DESIGN object; keep sealed data closed
terminal_logic.survivor: all 12 pass -> PROBE_SURVIVOR_DESIGN_ONLY; grants no downstream authority

acceptance_gates: Red-first synthetic tests cover joins, counts, stops, cost R, PF statuses, relative PF, yearly/cadence, DSR call and all 12 gate boundaries.
Tool import is inert and accepts one separately reviewed run packet; production inputs/outputs are not opened during implementation tests.
Independent quant/code review PASS before one production DESIGN economics run.
No parameter optimization, rescue, validation/holdout, MQL5 or Model0.
